messages:
jordan: FYI — Acme's security team asked for our full pen test report, vuln scan evidence, and a remediation timeline. They want it by Fri COB. Can eng-security/sales-ops help with deliverables?

sarah_eng: We have a 3rd-party pen test (RedTeamCo) from 2025-11-18. Full report contains customer IPs and exploit POCs — distribution requires NDA and portal access. We can produce a redacted report + raw scan exports today.

jordan: They said their vendor program requires the full unredacted package for internal review. Any way to accelerate NDA/portal access?

devsec-bot: New vendor-risk ticket created: VR-2026-47. Assigned to @sarah_eng and @mike_infra.

mike_infra: I can export Qualys/Nessus artifacts and sanitize hostnames. ETA 48h for sanitized bundle. Will include scan XML/CSV, vulnerability IDs, and evidence screenshots where allowed.

sarah_eng: Quick summary of pen test findings (top-level): 5 HIGH, 12 MED, 6 LOW. HIGH items: auth bypass in admin endpoint, S3 bucket ACL exposing model artifacts, RCE in model-serving runtime (path traversal to temp exec), exposed debug endpoint with creds, weak JWT rotation policy.

sarah_eng: Current status: 3 HIGH fully remediated (patch + config) as of 2026-03-02. 2 HIGH currently mitigated with WAF + runtime sandboxing; code fix scheduled for 2026-03-28 deploy. Overall remediation ETA for remaining HIGH = 2026-03-28.

jordan: Can we provide a signed attestation of remediation progress + the redacted artifacts to hold them while legal gets NDA in place? Customer prefers that over waiting for portal onboarding.

legal_ella: Legal ok to provide a signed remediation attestation + redacted artifacts. Full unredacted report only via secure vendor portal after NDA. I'll start the NDA template and loop in procurement.

sarah_eng: I'll assemble: 1) redacted pen test PDF (findings with POCs removed), 2) sanitized vulnerability scan exports (CSV + select screenshots), 3) remediation timeline doc (owner + PR links), and 4) signed attestation PDF. Links will be via secure S3 presigned URLs / vendor portal.

mike_infra: Scan exports will include CVE IDs (example: CVE-2023-XXXX, CVE-2024-YYYY), affected hosts masked, and ticket links to internal PRs. Example vuln rows: `CVE-2024-0001, model-serving-runtime, HIGH, PR#4521, remediation ETA 2026-03-28`.

jordan: Great — customer asked for evidence that fixes were verified. Do we have retest windows?

sarah_eng: We can run a targeted retest post-deploy. Target retest date: 2026-04-02 (72h after the deploy). We'll include retest plan and acceptance criteria in the bundle.

jordan: I'll offer attestation + redacted bundle now and portal access once NDA is signed. Will update the customer timeline: artifacts today, full report via portal after NDA + portal onboarding.

legal_ella: Confirmed — I'll send NDA draft to Acme by EOD. Once returned, we provision portal access and provide the full report.

jordan: Thanks everyone. Sending the proposed response to Acme now. :thumbsup:
